title: Field offset lies within the joined fields
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $fs$ be a finite list of finite lists of elements of $\Gamma$, and let $j<|fs|$. The offset of field $j$ plus the length of that field is at most the length of the list formed by joining the fields with blank separators.
hypotheses_covered: fs is a list of lists over Γ
j is less than the number of fields
